title: Advances and challenges in remediation technologies for uranium/radium-contaminated groundwater
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00910C, Critical Review
Kaijie Lin, Yuxuan Wan, Haiqing Chang, Huarong Yu, Haiyang Yang, Fangshu Qu
Critically evaluate uranium/radium-contaminated groundwater remediation technologies, focusing on its basic principles, application scenarios, current bottlenecks, and future research directions.
